assertion_analysis.failure_condition: A missing queued placement, position other than one or fallback reason fails; the ranked positive control proves the builder did useful work.
Removing cache reuse, rebuilding on timestamp-only edits or omitting the initial build changes the counted calls; output changes fail the prior-output invariance checks.
Restoring the reviewed broad signature rebuilds after the unqueued prose edit and gives two calls rather than one; this exact assertion is red in repair-negative-unrelated-plan.log.
Restoring plan-directory membership invalidation makes unqueued arrival/removal increase the build count.
Rebuilding on figure writes or changing placements after an unrelated write fails.

The first observed sprint listing proves the counter is attached; listing unchanged directories fails the empty assertion, a private cache survives file_memo.clear and fails the required fresh listing, and over-invalidation fails the one-build assertion.
Restoring file-stamp invalidation rebuilds after body prose/version/modified changes; including nested editorial fields survives this test because none are changed.

An ineffective fixture edit fails changed!=text; failing to invalidate a relevant state/wait/sprint/ROI/effort edit leaves one call; cached placements differing from a separately forced fresh computation fail equality, though one queued request cannot demonstrate relative reordering.
Ignoring queued-plan disappearance or return prevents the expected second or third build, and differing restored placements fail prior-output equality.

assertion_input_tethers: None: builder and listing counts compare independently observed events; output equality compares prior output or a forced fresh invocation rather than an input supplied to the code. The singleton fresh-result comparison has limited sensitivity to priority ordering.

blocking: The admitted importer evidence was produced by running the nine-file population directly in the fleet allocation: resume-1.jsonl:206 launches repair_gate.py with the pytest command, and repair_gate.py:14 executes it locally; repair-after-importers.log reports 167.97 seconds. The binding fleet rule requires importer populations to run as a separate partition job and treats in-place heavy evidence as a scope defect. Rerun matched arms via sbatch on all_debug or rigel and retain partition/job provenance before accepting this evidence.
